title: Start EMV payment transaction
description: Command to start an EMV Known Fare Transaction (KFT) on the validator, prepare to read the EMV card and show appropriate screen.

currencyExponent.description: Number of decimal digits for the currency (e.g., 2 for cents, 0 for JPY).

currencyCode.description: Numeric ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., 578 for Norwegian Krone).

products.description: List of products to be sold within this EMV transaction.

type.description: Type or identifier of the product (e.g., 'singleTicket', 'dayPass').

price.description: Product price in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents).

vatPercentage.description: VAT percentage applied to the product price (e.g., 12.0 for 12%).

productMedium.description: Medium information for the product delivery (e.g., card, paper).

type.description: Medium through which the product is issued or delivered.

serial.description: Optional serial number of the medium (e.g., card serial number).

countryCode.description: Numeric ISO 3166-1 country code (e.g., 578 for Norway).

userId.description: Identifier of the user initiating the transaction.

shiftId.description: Identifier of the current operator shift.

tapTimeoutSec.description: Maximum allowed time (in seconds) for a KFT tap to complete before timing out. If omitted, the validator's default configuration is used.

cancelWindowSec.description: Time window (in seconds) during which an accepted KFT transaction may be canceled. If omitted, the validator's default configuration is used.

message.description: Optional human-readable message to display or log about the EMV transaction start.

eventTimestamp.description: Timestamp for when the EMV transaction was initiated (UTC, RFC3339 format).
